# Market Claim Verifier

> Meta Muse Spark agents check financial claims against SEC EDGAR; Python owns the final numeric/evidence checks.

## Start here
- [Judge guide](JUDGES.md): criteria, 60-second path, evidence and limitations.
- [Verification instructions](AGENTS.md): no-key commands, prerequisites and expected output.
- [Offline entry point](scripts/verify.sh): tests, figures, byte comparisons and local Markdown links.
- [Website source](docs/site/index.html): saved demo; [explorer source](docs/explorer/index.html): per-claim evidence.

## Claims and their proof
- [Real-world News probe](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-02/REPORT.md): 80 paraphrased published-feed items on the current agent and post CLI across three providers. Four independent primary truth labels, 53 scope-only abstention expectations and 23 US items requiring review; do not call mixed agreement broad real-world accuracy.
- [Threads phase 2](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-02/REPORT.md#threads): 30 own posts, 48 third-party Top-search paraphrases and two real cards on three providers; five primary truth labels, 36 scope expectations and 37 review items. Unknown engagement counts; shown translation/unit findings, media coverage failures and all costs retained.
- [Agent and checks](src/claimcheck/agent.py), [program rules](src/claimcheck/checks.py), [recorded trace](docs/evidence/2026-10-27/20261027T222758Z-8959a100.json): model proposes; program checks numbers, periods and cited evidence.
- [Original v2 report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md): 357 claims, six systems; Baseten/Fireworks agents 323/357 (90.5%), Meta API agent 297/357 (83.2%). Single-shot: 74/357, 71/357, 158/357 respectively. Corrected gold; includes dev claims.
- [Registered-gold report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT-registered-gold.md), [frozen claims](eval/v2/claims-v2.jsonl), [corrected claims](eval/v2/claims-v2-corrected.jsonl): two gold corrections; 266 held-out claims.
- [Post-hoc report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-28-r2-posthoc/REPORT.md): agents only, same 357 claims; Fireworks 329/357, Baseten 325/357, Meta API 305/357. Fixes followed failure inspection; this is not a new held-out result.
- [Provider code](src/claimcheck/providers.py), [manifest](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/manifest.json), [model diagram](docs/diagrams/providers.mmd): Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API; open-weight Muse Spark Open via Baseten/Fireworks. Manifest records exact IDs, prompt/snapshot hashes and dirty-worktree status.
- [Prompts](prompts/), [replay tests](tests/test_live_replay.py), [figure registry](docs/figures/figures.json): auditable requests, replayed outputs and figure sources.
- [Build log](BUILD_LOG.md), [dated changelog](CHANGELOG.md): all repository work created during hackathon; first commit 2026-10-27, 7c5670b. Demo [opening disclosure](demo/JUDGE_INTRO.md); video publication URL pending.

## Boundaries and credits
- [Data policy](docs/DATA_SOURCES.md), [quality findings](docs/DATA_QUALITY.md): current SEC XBRL evidence tiers L1–L3, restatements and tagging limitations.
- [Original local-input probe](docs/evidence/multimodal-2026-10-29/REPORT.md), [hardening](docs/evidence/multimodal-2026-10-30/REPORT.md), [recall follow-up](docs/evidence/multimodal-2026-10-30b/REPORT.md), [Other inputs](README.md#other-inputs): the period-loss regression remains fixed and missing periods fail closed. Text EPS now correctly returns contradicted. Guarded/program-checked coverage on the 12-minute full-media control rose 19/60 → 44/60; a final frozen-ASR text recheck reaches 50/60 guarded assertions. Recall and speaker separation remain incomplete; one failed extraction attempt and insufficient-evidence verdicts are retained. These are post-hoc development probes; see the reports for all attempts, spend and source hashes.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): L4 earnings releases are implemented; full-call ingestion/verified speaker attribution, market-multiple claims remain planned; Taiwan is outside the current hackathon scope.
- [MIT license](LICENSE), [SEC/data/media credits](CREDITS.md), [media process](docs/PROCESS-media.md): distinguish verifier model calls from offline image/voice/music production.
